problem: Bot-authored Nightlogue PRs do not receive reliable independent Codex reviews because the Codex All PRs setting is unavailable, leaving GitHub reviews dependent on manual requests.
solution: After successful agent branch CI and the trusted Conductor PR handoff, use the existing restricted GitHub App token to request @codex review on the exact tested PR commit. Reject incomplete PR descriptions and stale heads, and deduplicate review requests by commit SHA.
tests: Node test suite for PR identity, full-description eligibility, duplicate SHA requests, API rejection and trusted workflow scope
GitHub CI lint, Prettier, TypeScript, Vitest, package checks and Storybook must pass on the final commit
Manual @codex review on bot-authored draft PR #76 completed successfully; bot-authored comment still requires a real integration test
risks: GitHub App-authored @codex review support is not yet proven. The App token has pull-request write permissions but the issue-comment endpoint must be verified. No automatic merge or production Claude dispatch is activated.
review: Verify trusted main-only script execution, no checkout of agent-branch code with the token, exact CI SHA matching, no duplicate requests, and a clear review hold for incomplete metadata.
